title: You're Not Ready for Martinfish
summary: Original Martinfish: Martin and Stockfish (depth 35) strictly alternate bot moves - Stockfish plays the bot's first move, Martin the next, and so on. Player (white, London) plays solid theory, grabs a free pawn after Martin's ...e5, exploits Martin's ...f6 and ...Kd7 king walks, and wins with Rxa7# after forced rook sacs.
rules: Bot moves strictly alternate: Stockfish (depth 35), Martin (250), Stockfish, Martin, ... with Stockfish moving first.
